equal channel angular pressing (ECAP) at high temperatures was utilized to activate simultaneous twinning-induced (TWIP) and transformation-induced plasticity (TRIP) in the CoCrFeMnNi high entropy alloy (HEA)

ECAP clearly shows a great potential for strengthening these materials via grain refinement, high defect density and the activation of simultaneous twinning and ε-martensite that provide significant resistance to dislocation activity.
The dynamic Hall-Patch effect decreases the dislocation mean free path and should increase the material's strength
